mapper.select: select id, tier, price_cents, currency, cny_price_cents, billing_type, billing_period, validity_months, private_introduction_quota, private_introduction_period, event_quota, event_priority_enabled, staff_review_enabled, profile_detail_access_level, staff_support_level, concierge_priority, featured, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at from cm_membership_plans where is_active = 1 order by sort_order

select id, tier, price_cents, currency, cny_price_cents, billing_type, billing_period, validity_months, private_introduction_quota, private_introduction_period, event_quota, event_priority_enabled, staff_review_enabled, profile_detail_access_level, staff_support_level, concierge_priority, featured, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at from cm_membership_plans where id = #{planId} limit 1

select id, user_id as userId, plan_id as planId, tier, status, started_at as startedAt, expires_at as expiresAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_user_memberships where user_id = #{userId} order by started_at desc limit 1

select id, user_id as userId, membership_id as membershipId, entitlement_code as entitlementCode, period_started_at as periodStartedAt, period_ends_at as periodEndsAt, quota_total as quotaTotal, quota_used as quotaUsed, quota_remaining as quotaRemaining, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_user_entitlement_balances where user_id = #{userId} and membership_id = #{membershipId} and period_started_at <= now() and period_ends_at > now() order by entitlement_code

select lf.plan_id as planId, lf.field_name as fieldName, lf.value from cm_membership_plan_localized_fields lf where lf.status = 'ready' and trim(lf.value) != '' and lf.field_name in ('name', 'description') order by lf.plan_id, lf.field_name, case lf.locale when #{locale} then 0 when 'zh' then 1 when 'en' then 2 else 3 end
mapper.update: update cm_user_memberships set status = 'expired', updated_at = now() where status = 'active' and expires_at is not null and expires_at <= now() order by expires_at, id limit #{batchSize}

update cm_user_memberships set status = 'expired', expires_at = coalesce(expires_at, now()), updated_at = now() where id in ( select id from ( select m.id from cm_user_memberships m where m.status = 'active' and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now()) and exists ( select 1 from cm_user_memberships better where better.user_id = m.user_id and better.status = 'active' and (better.expires_at is null or better.expires_at > now()) and ( case better.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end > case m.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end or ( case better.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end = case m.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end and better.started_at > m.started_at ) or ( case better.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end = case m.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end and better.started_at = m.started_at and better.created_at > m.created_at ) or ( case better.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end = case m.tier when 'diamond' then 4 when 'gold' then 3 when 'silver' then 2 when 'free' then 1 else 0 end and better.started_at = m.started_at and better.created_at = m.created_at and better.id > m.id ) ) ) order by m.user_id, m.started_at limit #{batchSize} ) t )
mapper.select: select u.id from cm_users u where u.status = 'active' and not exists ( select 1 from cm_user_memberships m where m.user_id = u.id and m.status = 'active' and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now()) ) order by u.created_at, u.id limit #{batchSize}
mapper.update: update cm_user_memberships set status = 'active', started_at = now(), expires_at = null, updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and tier = 'free' order by created_at desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_user_memberships (id, user_id, plan_id, tier, status, started_at) select #{id}, #{userId}, id, tier, 'active', now() from cm_membership_plans where tier = 'free' and is_active = 1 limit 1
